evals.prompt: Make me a short 5-slide seed-round pitch deck for a fictional startup called 'Ledgerly' (AI bookkeeping for freelancers), using the Stripe design system.
evals.expected_output: Binds stripe + a non-stub deck template that accepts a design system (e.g. simple-deck) in .open-design.json; writes a 5-slide index.html in cwd using Stripe tokens.

evals.prompt: build a SaaS analytics dashboard prototype for our churn metrics that looks like Linear
evals.expected_output: Binds linear design system + a prototype-mode dashboard template; reads craft files listed in od.craft.requires; writes the dashboard into cwd.

evals.prompt: I need a video generation prompt for a 15s product teaser of a smart water bottle, something cinematic
evals.expected_output: Uses list-prompt-templates.mjs video to pick a suitable template, fills its argument placeholders from the brief, and returns the completed prompt.
